name: RBPI Group
verdict: Kaliningrad agro-industrial group (RBPI Group / ООО «УК РБПИ ГРУПП»).
note: Rating note: EGRUL (via checko.ru) shows ООО «УК РБПИ ГРУПП» is 100% owned by АО «Правдинское свино производство», itself 100% held by RBPI (Thailand) Company Limited since November 2024; the individuals behind the Thai holding are unidentified, so Nothing found is proposed with the chain as far as the register shows. No human-rights finding against the company found.
